reserveReview.rationale: Classification-only review on 2026-10-20 adds the exact keyed Frontier Morpho VaultV2 as a protocol-position. Explorer-verified source at 0x9a1d6bd5b8642c41f25e0958129b85f8e1176f3e implements ERC-4626 shares over adapter investments, rather than a direct USDC balance. The issuer basket proposal identifies the same Frontier strategy. Its zero-percent row is classification metadata for the live adapter key, not measured zero exposure; runtime weights remain producer-owned. No coinId, obligor census, maturity maximum, reserve realization horizon or executable liquidity is inferred. The retained 33.33/33.34/33.33 rows remain the historical July 20 composition, not today's basket. That historical observation at Ethereum block 25575568 (2026-07-20T17:58:47Z) measured BackingManager 0xf014fef41ccb703975827c8569a3f0940cfd80a4 balances of 6513292.234353 wcUSDCv3, 7129655.677323 wcUSDTv3 and 6595709.630305 saEthUSDC, corroborating BasketHandler's three equal-weight positions and rejecting an earlier invented secondary-manager split. This classification review does not renew that composition or claim full current portfolio coverage. All liquidity questions require same-pin positions and available assets, gates/caps and actual withdrawal mechanics; generic permission to withdraw is insufficient.
reserveReview.compositionBasis: Historical July 20, 2026 pinned BasketHandler/BackingManager observation at Ethereum block 25575568, cross-checked against 25537982; separate zero-percent live-key classification metadata reviewed 2026-10-20
reserveReview.knownUnknownExposure: Historical July basket rows remain linked to their underlying stablecoins. The live Frontier keyed row establishes protocol-position class only; current borrowers/obligors, allocations, maturity and amount-specific liquidity are not established by the vault name or denomination.

custodyProfile.uncertainty: The reviewed sources establish that EUSD's reserve contracts hold positions in Aave and Compound lending protocols, but they do not establish a legal custody wrapper, bankruptcy remoteness, provider allocation, or a separate offchain custodian. Rehypothecation is marked permitted because the reserve positions are supplied into lending markets by design.
